Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while the patient's vehicle was turning left, with resulting right
shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force
of the impact described. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider. Over the course of care the
patient attended 22 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of shoulder injury. Physical
examination revealed findings that support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including limited abduction and
tenderness over the rotator cuff region, while several other tests, including neurological screening and strength
testing of the upper extremity, returned normal results. Treatment consisted of guided physical therapy, a home
exercise program, and anti-inflammatory medication. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicated or
repeated charges for services. Current status is improving, with continued monitoring and a plan for reassessment at
the next scheduled visit.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
